mechanism: Aerial heat and desiccation of intertidal oysters at low tide; 2021 heat dome coincident with lowest tides caused mass mortality

mechanism: Controls hours of air exposure and neap-tide flushing; modulator of heat and DO stress

mechanism: Raises metabolism; summer mortality co-factor; NANOOS grower note flags >64F for >24h; spawning generally >18-20C

mechanism: Hypoxia co-stressor with heat and neap tides in Puget Sound summer mortality; stratified basins (Hood Canal)

mechanism: Euryhaline species; acute freshwater pulses plus TSS/DO/contaminants drive flood mortalities

mechanism: Delivers low salinity turbidity nutrients and sometimes contaminants to estuarine leases
data_availability_note: NWS QPF plus gauged rivers; not a direct oyster measurement.

mechanism: Gear loss burial stranding and inability to work tides; operational disruption not physiology
data_availability_note: NWS marine forecasts; local fetch matters.

mechanism: Food for growth and condition (Willapa fattening-line contrast); weak as 72h mortality unless HAB crash
data_availability_note: NANOOS/satellite chl available; never treat as oyster abundance (stock is planted).

mechanism: Clogs feeding; rises with runoff and storms; co-stressor in flood mortality literature
data_availability_note: Some NERRS turbidity; often unobserved at lease.

mechanism: Impairs larval calcification; 2009 WA seed crisis. Weak for 72h adult farm mortality
data_availability_note: NOAA OAP and some NANOOS carbonate; do not headline for adult farm v1.

mechanism: Fuels phytoplankton and some HABs; indirect for 72h mortality

mechanism: Explains Willapa spatial growth (upper vs lower estuary residence time) at seasonal scale
data_availability_note: Published oceanography (Banas et al. 2007) not a 72h nowcast product.

mechanism: Only via tides; no independent 72h mortality mechanism found

mechanism: Ripe summer oysters more vulnerable to summer mortality; degree-day process
data_availability_note: No public real-time condition index; use calendar prior only.

mechanism: Causes mass farm mortality where present (CA sentinels); not detected at OR/WA test sites in 2020

mechanism: Intertidal vs subtidal vs bottom vs raft changes exposure to air heat vs hypoxia

mechanism: Skin temperature; proxy for well-mixed shallow water heat; misses air T on emersion and stratified DO

mechanism: Human harvest legality under NSSP; not oyster physiological stress
data_availability_note: WA DOH official; exclude from operational-stress target.

mechanism: WDFW 2019: oysters failed ordinary handling/crowding during die-offs
data_availability_note: Only in farm records.

mechanism: Archival tags: adults persistently occupy ~8-12C and change depth when surface warms

mechanism: Surface proxy for thermal habitat availability; NOT Chinook abundance
data_availability_note: Easy IOOS/CoastWatch layers; forbidden as a fish count.

mechanism: Vertical placement of the 8-12C band used by tagged adults
data_availability_note: Gliders buoys and models uneven off CA/OR; Newport Line is biweekly not 48h.

mechanism: Indexes productivity and in JUNE WA/OR surveys juvenile presence; for adults a food-web proxy NOT a head count

mechanism: Structures SST chl hypoxia and prey; seasonal-to-event scale
data_availability_note: PFEL/NOAA upwelling indices; not fish abundance.

mechanism: Adults and especially juveniles more likely on shelf; recreational catch often nearer shore than commercial troll
data_availability_note: Bathymetry official; still not a count.

mechanism: Strong for juveniles shortly after ocean entry; adults stock-specific and seasonal
data_availability_note: Do not emit river-mouth hotspots for listed ESUs; many mouths closed by regulation.

mechanism: Adults piscivorous; local prey can concentrate fish
data_availability_note: Rarely observed lawfully at 48h public resolution.

mechanism: Determines whether charters leave port and catchability while trolling
data_availability_note: NWS marine forecasts; first-order for realized CPUE.

mechanism: Columbia Klamath and smaller plumes structure turbidity and prey; also special legal closures
data_availability_note: Satellite reflectance plus gauges; do not target closed control zones.

mechanism: Minor for offshore troll relative to wind and thermocline; relevant near mouths
data_availability_note: Tide tables; not a primary ocean-Chinook predictor.

mechanism: Unverified for CA/OR ocean Chinook troll encounter at 48h

mechanism: If the area is closed or guideline attained there is no lawful encounter product

mechanism: Other boats equal effort crowding and sometimes information; NOT fish abundance

mechanism: May cap vertical habitat during strong upwelling hypoxia

mechanism: Built for juvenile marine survival and adult returns 1-2 years later

mechanism: Generally not limiting in GOM inshore relative to temperature
